Class IRImage

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.Image
global.thalion.ttio.IRImage
public class IRImage extends Image
Infrared hyperspectral imaging dataset: width × height pixel grid, each pixel an IR spectrum of spectralPoints intensity values sampled at a shared wavenumber axis.

Stored under /study/ir_image_cube/ as a 3-D float64 intensity cube with a 1-D wavenumbers axis.

API status: Stable (v0.11, M73).

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOIRImage, Python ttio.ir_image.IRImage.

  • Constructor Details

    • IRImage

      public IRImage(int width, int height, int spectralPoints, int tileSize, double pixelSizeX, double pixelSizeY, String scanPattern, Enums.IRMode mode, double resolutionCmInv, double[] intensityCube, double[] wavenumbers, String title, String isaInvestigationId, List<Identification> identifications, List<Quantification> quantifications, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenanceRecords)
      Full constructor capturing every cube dimension and study-level annotation.
      Parameters:
      width - image width in pixels
      height - image height in pixels
      spectralPoints - points along the wavenumber axis
      tileSize - chunk side for HDF5 storage; 0 means use full-image chunking
      pixelSizeX - pixel pitch in micrometres along X
      pixelSizeY - pixel pitch in micrometres along Y
      scanPattern - free-form scan pattern label
      mode - IR acquisition mode (TRANSMITTANCE / ABSORBANCE); null defaults to TRANSMITTANCE
      resolutionCmInv - spectral resolution in cm^-1
      intensityCube - row-major flat cube of shape [height, width, spectralPoints]
      wavenumbers - per-band wavenumber axis values
      title - study title; null becomes empty
      isaInvestigationId - ISA investigation identifier; null becomes empty
      identifications - dataset-level identifications; null becomes empty
      quantifications - dataset-level quantifications; null becomes empty
      provenanceRecords - dataset-level provenance chain; null becomes empty
